question: Which divine names are sung and which will be?
premises: Glorious Sadashiva, Deva, and Ishana are sung.
Vishnu, Vama, Kajy, and Aghora are named.
inference: The verse lists divine names in sung and future registers.
uncertainties: The token kajy is unclear and may be a name or sandhi.
plain_english: Glorious Sadashiva, Deva, and Ishana are sung; Vishnu, Vama, Kajy, and Aghora will also be.
